items.title: Garrett Wilson: Reportedly clear for Week 10
items.text:
Wilson (concussion) reportedly cleared the concussion protocol and is expected to play in Sunday's game versus the Bills, per Ian Rapoport of NFL Network.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Denzel Boston: Expected to play Sunday
items.text:
Boston (toe), who is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Texans, is expected to play barring a surprise, Jeremy Fowler of ESPN reports.
